title: Vendor Booking Coverage
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:vendor
| stats count as booked, values(category) as categories by status
| eventstats sum(booked) as total
description: Shows which essential vendor categories are booked, in progress, or still open so nothing critical is left to chance.
value: A booking-coverage view stops a key supplier being overlooked until it is too late to book one.
implementation: Ingest vendor records into `index=personal`; summarise coverage by status and category.
visualization: Table of vendor categories by booking status.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which suppliers you have booked and which you still need, so nothing essential is left unbooked.
